note: Every pack charges on its own parallel board. Rules v7: a pack is pulled only for fire risk, and a pack that fails a board check charges alone that night only. Watch and performance notes are notes. C1-P1 is back on the C1 board from the next storage night. C1-P4 and C2-P2 are back on their boards. C3 and C4 have no recorded board night yet. Series do not share a board.
